data.title: From preparedness to response: EU Reference Laboratories for Public Health in action
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Strong laboratory capacity is the backbone of Europe’s preparedness in the face of increasing communicable disease threats, said ECDC on the occasion of today’s European Laboratory Day, celebrated every year on 5 November to recognise the essential contribution of laboratory professionals across Europe.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: From preparedness to response: EU Reference Laboratories for Public Health in action

data.title: First public health emergency preparedness assessments across Europe show both commitment and recurring challenges
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: The first cycle of Public Health Emergency Preparedness Assessments (PHEPAs) coordinated by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has shown a strong commitment to emergency preparedness across Europe, with a number of common challenges remaining.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: First public health emergency preparedness assessments across Europe show both commitment and recurring challenges

data.title: As the cold season nears, universal immunisation of newborns against RSV could significantly reduce infant hospitalisations across Europe
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: As the season for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and other respiratory diseases approaches, a new report from the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) indicates that universal immunisation of newborns against RSV could substantially reduce hospitalisations among infants linked to the disease during the winter season.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: As the cold season nears, universal immunisation of newborns against RSV could significantly reduce infant hospitalisations across Europe

data.title: ECDC to deploy experts as Ebola cases emerge in Kenya and Nigeria
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Following the emergence of Ebola disease in Kenya and Nigeria, and with the situation in the DRC remaining serious, ECDC is increasing its efforts to support investigations and local response by sending a team of ECDC experts to Nigeria.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: ECDC to deploy experts as Ebola cases emerge in Kenya and Nigeria

data.title: Importation of Ebola cases to Kenya and Nigeria: ECDC assesses the threat
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: With cases of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus recently detected in Kenya and Nigeria, ECDC reiterates the low risk for Europe while highlighting the need for preparedness.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: Importation of Ebola cases to Kenya and Nigeria: ECDC assesses the threat

data.title: Respiratory infections season
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: As the colder months approach in Europe, respiratory infections including influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections, COVID-19, pneumococcal disease and others can lead to serious illness and increase the burden on healthcare services throughout Europe.

data.title: Severely ill patient in France becomes first ever human infected with Shamonda virus
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) is carefully monitoring the situation after the French authorities announced the first ever reported human infection with Shamonda virus (SHAV), a disease that has until now only affected animals.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: Severely ill patient in France becomes first ever human infected with Shamonda virus

data.title: Ebola disease: Multi-country outbreak 2026
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Since May 2026, an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has been ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

data.title: Strengthening public health emergency operations centres in Europe through exchange of good practices
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: A three-day training workshop organised by ECDC and WHO/Europe and hosted by the Slovenian National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) brought together participants from the EU and a number of accession countries to strengthen their national Public Health Emergency Operations Centres (PHEOCs) and to ensure they operate in line with EU and international standards.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: Strengthening public health emergency operations centres in Europe through exchange of good practices
